title: ION Trade Commitment Schema Pack v1
description: JSON Schema 2020-12 mirror of the trade/commitment/v1 OpenAPI schema pack. The root resolves to IONTradeCommitment, which inherits directly from RetailCommitment v2.1.

IONTradeCommitment.title: IONTradeCommitment
IONTradeCommitment.description: ION trade commitment attributes. Inherits directly from RetailCommitment v2.1 and adds replacement preference semantics. The former ION-specific layer defined no additional properties, so no x-attr-ion-layer markers are needed.

replacementPreferred.description: Whether the buyer prefers replacement over refund for this committed line if the supplied resource is defective, incorrect, or otherwise eligible for remediation. This is line-specific because different commitments in the same contract may require different remedies.
